title: Automate changelog and onboard aurora-spark-13b v1.1 (perf metadata + profiles)
author: Priya Desai
release_notes:
- Onboard aurora-spark-13b v1.1: metadata, perf profiles, and sample benchmarks.
- Add automated changelog generation entry for model registry onboarding events.
- Small fix to perf profile schema validation to support quantized variants.
description: Motivation: Aurora-spark-13b v1.1 is a follow-up release from the upstream model provider with improved attention kernel stability and a new quantized checkpoint. We need to add canonical metadata, curated performance profiles for our serving runtime, and wire the onboarding steps into our changelog automation so product and docs teams receive release notes automatically. What this PR does: 1) Adds aurora-spark-13b v1.1 metadata (model card, tokenizer settings, canonical config). 2) Adds perf profiles for common sequence lengths (32, 128, 512) including GPU throughput and latency targets for dedicated and hosted tiers. 3) Extends the changelog automation to pick up new entries from models/metadata/** and generate a release fragment used by the model-registry release notes pipeline. 4) Adds a lightweight validation step to the onboarding pipeline that runs perf profile lint and schema checks in CI. Implementation notes: - Metadata lives under models/aurora-spark/13b/v1.1/metadata.json and includes tags for quantization-friendly and recommended default quant params. - Perf profiles are under models/aurora-spark/13b/v1.1/perf/*.yaml and follow the existing perf schema; added missing p99_latency_ms field and quantized_variant boolean. - Changelog automation: updated tools/changelog/collector.py to include model-registry paths, and templates/changelog/model_onboard.md.j2 for rendering. Testing: Local unit tests for schema validation added; CI runs full schema and perf profile lint; a small end-to-end smoke test runs the release fragment generation with a sample model directory. Rollout: This is a non-breaking additive change; changelog automation is guarded behind a feature flag CHG_AUTOMATE_MODEL_ONBOARD. Follow-ups: add sample eval harness for aurora-spark and include in perf-lab benchmarks.
commit_summary: Squash of 9 commits: add aurora-spark v1.1 metadata and model card; add perf profiles for 32/128/512 seq; update perf schema to include p99_latency_ms; changelog collector: include model paths; add changelog template; add CI lint and unit tests; fix CI flake in collection step; update docs reference; bump version.
